answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: peers slash the stake if the identity proves hollow, with no real work behind it. Honest agents recover the deposit through attested jobs, so the cost is a loan, not a fee. For an attacker, the price of each new fake multiplies like a vine, branching with every sparrow they spawn, while a shared registry blacklists duplicates before they can collect rewards.
